The average CGPA of third-year Computer Science (CS) students is 8.21 [SQL].

This figure represents the average CGPA for all students in the CS department currently in their third year of study [SQL].
sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(s.cgpa) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_cgpa FROM students AS s JOIN departments AS d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.code = 'CS' AND s.year_of_study = 3 LIMIT 200
